controls.title: Detection and monitoring: the entity uses detection and monitoring procedures to identify changes to configurations (title paraphrased; the draft's wording is not reproduced here)

assertions.statement: Every observed scope had a healthy observation feed for the whole window; a blind stretch is stated, not assumed clean.
Every change seen and not cleared has a recorded resolution.
No operation turned off, narrowed or deleted the controls that watch the environment.
No change landed outside a clearance, in a window whose observation feeds were verified.
The records this packet rests on are under a witnessed ledger checkpoint.
